event.name: Ex-Hurricane Ophelia urban wind impacts in Ireland

required_claims: wind and gust peak at 14:00 before the pressure minimum
rainfall is modest compared with the wind-pressure signal
official Dublin gust is close to the point-weather gust

provenance.notes: Values are calculated from local CSX-118 weather JSON and the local NHC report PDF.

criteria.description: States that the Dublin record is a wind-pressure timing core, not a rain-accumulation core.
criteria.name: Core classification
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for a wind-led label that does not make the timing contrast explicit.

criteria.description: Reports peak gust 111.6 km/h and peak wind 61.4 km/h at 2017-10-16T14:00, plus minimum pressure 989.6 hPa at 2017-10-16T15:00.
criteria.name: Hourly extrema
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct values with one missing time or minor rounding within 0.2 units.

criteria.description: Computes the 1.0 hour lag from wind and gust peak to pressure minimum and the 1.82 gust-to-wind ratio.
criteria.name: Derived timing and ratio
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for one correct derived value or a correct formula with arithmetic slips.

criteria.description: Uses 5.8 mm total point rainfall and 0.9 mm maximum hourly rain to keep rain accumulation secondary.
criteria.name: Rainfall contrast
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for the correct total without the hourly check, or for a correct low-rain conclusion with imprecise rounding.

criteria.description: Converts the official 56 kt Dublin Airport gust to 103.7 km/h and computes the 7.9 km/h point-minus-official gust gap.
criteria.name: Official table reconciliation
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for the correct knot value or conversion without the gap.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON and a short explanation that stays within the computed weather ledger.
criteria.name: Concise ledger and wording
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for a mostly complete ledger with minor format omissions and no extra outside numbers.
